observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor desert setting during daylight, with a sandy ground and spectators gathered around
observation.dancers: mixed group of women and men; women dance solo or in pairs in the center while men and other women sit or stand around clapping and singing
observation.formation_and_space: concentric semi-circle of seated or kneeling spectators surrounding one or two dancers in the center
observation.posture: dancers are kneeling or sitting low on the ground with upright torsos, heads covered with veils
observation.footwork: kneeling on the ground; foot stepping and weight transfer cannot be seen
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extended forward or raised at shoulder height, hands performing intricate finger fluttering and articulation
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle upper body movements and torso sway
observation.partnering: none; solo or independent dancers sharing the central space
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level only, staying on knees throughout; no jumps or turns visible
observation.costume_and_props: women wear long dresses, headbands with coins or beads, and dark veils covering parts of the head/face; men wear traditional blue and white tunics and head wraps
observation.cannot_infer: footwork and lower body weight shifts are entirely occluded by long dresses and kneeling position; exact acoustic details of instruments other than percussion drums are uncertain.

signature_moments.what: Dancer kneeling on the ground with arms outstretched, rhythmically fluttering fingers and hands.
Dancer kneeling in the center under a black veil, moving hands expressively while surrounding group claps.
Two women kneeling facing each other, mirroring hand gestures and finger fluttering.
